item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces continue raids in the occupied West Bank, targeting villages, NGOs and staff, while settlers set fire to a mosque and attacked olive harvesters. In Gaza, Israeli air strikes killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and a girl was rescued from a flaming apartment after an attack, while the Israeli Yellow Line advanced, leaving displaced residents with nowhere to go. The Israeli government is pursuing the reopening of settler Route 463, which would further isolate Ramallah. An article describes Israel's use of AI in Gaza as a tool of genocide. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
